sn56.37:1.1: Suriyassa bhikkhave udayato etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittam yad idam aruṇuggam ||
sn56.37:1.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtam abhisamayāya etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yad idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi || || 3.
sn56.37:1.4: Idam dukkhan ti yathābhutam pajānissati || la-pe || Ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānissati || ||
sn56.37:2.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāmiṇī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || || 2.
